classes.description: MfgOrder Task List — 制造工单任务清单定义实体（CdoId: 8911，版本控制对象）。定义制造工单(MfgOrder)执行过程中需要完成的任务列表(tasks)，支持顺序(Sequential)或非顺序(Non-Sequential)执行模式(executionMode)，可指定工作站(workstation/stationGroup)。与 ProcessList 类似但专用于工单执行上下文。 【Swagger】Schema: MfgOrderTaskListEntity；来源文件: MfgOrderTaskLists.json；API: /api/MfgOrderTaskLists。

properties.name: isImage
properties.description: 关联的映像版本对象。 【Swagger】引用 Schema: RevisionedObjectRef。

properties.name: executionMode
properties.description: 任务执行模式（必填）：1=Sequential, 2=Non-Sequential 【Swagger】Identifies whether the Tasks are to be performed in sequence. 1 = Sequential 2 = Non-Sequential

properties.name: filterTags
properties.description: 以逗号分隔的筛选标签列表。 【Swagger】FilterTags comma seperated list

properties.name: notes
properties.description: 备注信息 【Swagger】Notations and comments associated with this object.

properties.name: changeHistory
properties.description: 变更历史记录 【Swagger】引用 Schema: ChangeHistoryChanges。

properties.name: description
properties.description: 描述说明 【Swagger】Description of this entity. Defaults to the name of this entity if not specified

properties.name: iconId
properties.description: 关联的图标 ID 【Swagger】Identifier for the icon associated with this Base Entity

properties.name: isFrozen
properties.description: 是否已冻结（只读） 【Swagger】Determines if changes are allowed to this instance

properties.name: revision
properties.description: 版本号（必填） 【Swagger】Revision (unique within the context of the base entity)

properties.name: wipMsgDefMgr
properties.description: 关联的WIP消息定义管理器（WIPMsgDefMgr）。 【Swagger】引用 Schema: WIPMsgEntity。

properties.name: instruction
properties.description: 用户执行任务列表中任务的说明。 【Swagger】Instructions for the user on how to execute the Tasks in the TaskList.

properties.name: prerequisiteTaskList
properties.description: 关联的先决任务列表。 【Swagger】引用 Schema: RevisionedObjectRef。

properties.name: reportInstruction
properties.description: 用户执行任务列表中任务的说明（无显示格式），主要用于报告。 【Swagger】Instructions for the user on how to execute the Tasks in the TaskList without any display format applied. Used primarly for reporting purposes where markup and tags are not supported.

properties.name: workstation
properties.description: 指定执行任务的工作站 【Swagger】引用 Schema: NamedObjectRef。

properties.name: workstationGroup
properties.description: 指定执行任务的工作站组 【Swagger】引用 Schema: NamedObjectRef。

properties.name: status
properties.description: 状态：1=Active, 2=Inactive 【Swagger】Determines the current status (Active, In-Active) of this instance. Valid values and their meanings are: 1 = Active 2 = Inactive

properties.name: eco
properties.description: 工程变更单号 【Swagger】Engineering Change Order

properties.name: variantExpression
properties.description: 物理字段 VariantExpression 【Swagger】Variant expression to be resolved to allow for filtering out configurable activities.
